# Downloaders


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

[`download_eval`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/downloaders.html#download_eval)
saves every document of an
[`Evaluation`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/readers.html#evaluation)
in `dst/<id>/`, named after the last part of its URL.
[`Report.download`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/pipeline.html#report.download)
in the pipeline uses it.
[`download_evals`](https://franckalbinet.github.io/iomeval/downloaders.html#download_evals)
runs it on many evaluations in parallel. Both read the evaluation’s
fields through `cfg`, which defaults to `default_config`.

### download_eval

``` python
def download_eval(
    eval:iomeval.readers.Evaluation, # Evaluation whose documents to download
    dst:str='files/test/eval_reports', # Folder to create the evaluation's folder in
    cfg:dict={'id': 'id', 'docs': 'docs', 'url': 'url'}, # Names of the `id`, `docs` and `url` fields
)->pathlib.Path: # The evaluation's folder, `dst/<id>/`
```

*Download every document of `eval` to `dst/<id>/`, overwriting files
with the same name*

``` python
fname = 'files/test/evaluations.json'
evals = load_evals(fname)
evl = evals[0]
evl
```

### download_evals

``` python
def download_evals(
    evals:fastcore.foundation.L, # Evaluations, or a single `Evaluation`
    dst:str='files/test/eval_reports', # Folder to create the evaluations' folders in
    cfg:dict={'id': 'id', 'docs': 'docs', 'url': 'url'}, # Names of the `id`, `docs` and `url` fields
    n_workers:int=4, # Number of parallel downloads
)->fastcore.foundation.L: # The evaluations' folders
```

*Download the documents of `evals` in parallel, one folder per
evaluation*

``` python
eval_dirs = download_evals(evals[:3])
eval_dirs
```
